title: Uma Stats
description: HAVE YOU EVER WANTED A GOOD HORSE?! Well this datapack lists the stats of any horse you sit on!
body:
## Hiya!
This datapack checks players sitting on an Uma and will calculate and display that Uma's stats in chat!

When you sit on a horse it triggers an advancement (no tick function needed!!), it then finds the horse that player is sitting on and reads it's attributes making it even work with modified horses from different datapacks!

(you can even toggle off the chat text if it's in the way :o)
